description: Build staff management UI for admins to view and create staff accounts with constituency assignments. Add a new 'Staff' or 'Team' page in the admin navigation that lists all admin and reviewer users with their assigned constituencies. Add a form to create new staff accounts with fields: full_name, email, password, role (admin/reviewer dropdown), constituency (dropdown populated from distinct bursary constituencies). Backend: implement GET /api/staff to list staff users (admin+reviewer roles only) and ensure POST /api/admin/users properly saves constituency (already implemented in FEAT-001).
steps: In backend/app/main.py, add GET /api/staff endpoint after the existing POST /api/admin/users endpoint (around line ~141). Use Depends(require_roles('admin')) for auth. Query: 'staff_users = db.scalars(select(User).where(User.role.in_(["admin", "reviewer"])).order_by(User.full_name)).all()'. Return list of dicts: '[{"id": u.id, "full_name": u.full_name, "email": u.email, "role": u.role, "constituency": u.constituency or "", "active": u.active} for u in staff_users]'.

In frontend/src/App.jsx, add 'Staff' page to the staff navigation items. Locate the navItems definition (around line with navItems=staff?[...]) and add ['staff', 'Team', Users] to the staff array (before 'reports').

In frontend/src/App.jsx, after the existing page conditionals (after page==='reports'), add: {page==='staff' && staff && <StaffPage staffList={staffList} setStaffList={setStaffList} busy={busy} run={run} refresh={refresh} constituencies={constituencies} setConstituencies={setConstituencies}/>}. Add state for staffList and constituencies at the top of the App component: const [staffList, setStaffList] = useState([]); const [constituencies, setConstituencies] = useState([]);

In the refresh function in App.jsx, add fetch for staff list and constituencies if user is admin: 'if (getSavedUser()?.role === "admin") { setStaffList(await api("/staff")); const constData = await api("/bursaries/constituencies"); setConstituencies(constData.map(c => c.constituency)); }'

In frontend/src/App.jsx, define the StaffPage component function before the return statement of App (after the existing page component functions like ReportsPage). Structure: function StaffPage({staffList, setStaffList, busy, run, refresh, constituencies, setConstituencies}) { const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false); async function createStaff(e) { e.preventDefault(); const fd = new FormData(e.currentTarget); await run(async () => { await api('/admin/users', {method: 'POST', body: {full_name: fd.get('full_name'), email: fd.get('email'), password: fd.get('password'), role: fd.get('role'), constituency: fd.get('constituency')}}); setShowCreate(false); await refresh(); }); } return <>...</>; }

StaffPage JSX structure: <PageHeading eyebrow="TEAM MANAGEMENT" title="Staff & Reviewers" desc="Manage admin and reviewer accounts with constituency assignments." action={<Button onClick={()=>setShowCreate(!showCreate)}><Plus size={17}/> Add staff member</Button>}/>. If showCreate, render a form panel similar to create-form in BursariesPage: fields for full_name (input required), email (input type=email required), password (input type=password minLength=12 required placeholder='Minimum 12 characters'), role (select: option admin, option reviewer), constituency (select with option value='' 'No assignment', then constituencies.map option). Form actions: submit button 'Create account', cancel button.

acceptance_criteria: GET /api/staff endpoint exists and returns list of admin and reviewer users with id, full_name, email, role, constituency, active fields
GET /api/staff is admin-only (returns 403 for non-admin users)
Frontend has 'Team' navigation item in admin sidebar
Staff page displays table of all admin and reviewer accounts with columns: Name, Email, Role, Constituency, Status
Staff page has 'Add staff member' button that shows a creation form
Creation form has fields: full_name, email, password (min 12 chars), role (dropdown: admin/reviewer), constituency (dropdown: constituencies from bursaries + 'No assignment')
Submitting the form creates a new staff user via POST /api/admin/users and refreshes the staff list
Created staff users appear in the staff list immediately
Constituency column shows badge with constituency name if assigned, '—' if not assigned
Role column shows badge (admin=success green, reviewer=info blue)
Status column shows Active/Disabled badge based on active field

Click Team, verify staff page loads and shows existing admin user in table
Click 'Add staff member', verify form appears with all required fields

Submit form, verify no error and form closes
Verify 'John Reviewer' appears in the staff table with role=reviewer badge, constituency='Webuye East' badge, status=Active
Logout, login as john@test.com with the password, verify login succeeds and user has reviewer role
Check GET /api/staff endpoint in browser DevTools or API docs, verify it returns the staff list with all fields
